The answer has no receipts[]/rejected[] and no entry naming the submitted receiptId. breaks.expected: Out-of-order and duplicate batches must be safe and replay the durable verdict: an exact redelivery of a settled receipt answers delivery=replayed, status=result_recorded, financialDisposition=consumed regardless of the current release freeze (the freeze may only gate NEW chargeable settlements).

After read_analysis_release_policy reports the same release as deny_new (not withdrawn), the byte-identical receipt is answered {"delivery":"pending","reconciliation":{"status":"pending","financialDisposition":"reserved"}} and the settlement RPC is not called. reconcileOfflineReceipts (index.ts) evaluates the freeze before the durable replay lookup, so the wire verdict contradicts the ledger (consumed reported as reserved). The mobile maps 'pending' to held, keeps the receipt queued and backs off sync for the whole freeze.

Attack branch devin/pp/w04-04/attack-afb40817 @ f91d9f8f76acecf5d0d85f0d7844bb0a6088ebf2 (parent afb40817; one file added: supabase/functions/api/__wf__/attack_w04_04_receipts.test.ts, 1463 lines; no production code or candidate tests touched; deno fmt/lint/check of the file clean).

ATTACK RUN (VERIFIED) — cmd: cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && XC_PG_URL=postgres://postgres:pg@127.0.0.1:55433/postgres deno test -A --no-check --config deno.json attack_w04_04_receipts.test.ts → exit 1, 12 executed / 8 passed / 4 failed / 0 ignored (log attack_candidate_afb40817.log). Failing = confirmed breaks: A1 (P1 wire contract), A2a (P1 freeze masks consumed verdict), A2b + A2c (P2 freeze masks conflict / durable hold). Same file on BASE 7cfeacbb (git worktree, own disposable postgres with base migrations, port 55434) → exit 1, 0 passed / 12 failed (route 'Unknown endpoint: POST /v1/offline/receipts', function public.settle_offline_receipt does not exist; log attack_base_7cfeacbb.log) — so every passing attack is candidate-specific behaviour.

ATTACKS TRIED (12 tests, 10 classes): A1 wire contract with shipping app drain — BROKE. A2a/A2b/A2c reversible deny-new freeze vs durable settled/held/conflict verdicts — BROKE (3). A3 boundaries (empty/26/non-array/missing batch → 400 no RPC; 25-entry batch with 24 malformed entries settles exactly the valid one; in-batch duplicate ids replay, same-id/different-digest conflicts; oversized body → 413) — held. A4 network failure mid-batch (5xx, 429+Retry-After, 502, malformed row, empty row from the RPC on entry 2 → generic 503, entry 1 durable and replays, nothing fabricated; release-authority unavailable → 503 with no settlement) — held. A5 clocks (grant expired 40 days ago settles via delayed verification at exp-1; future-iat grant HELD; tampered exp HELD, nothing consumed) — held. A6 account switch (B presenting A's receipt+grant → owner_mismatch HOLD under B, nothing settled for A, RPC authorized as B; A settles once later; B's own same-id receipt independent) — held. A7 live concurrency (8-way double submit consumes once + 7 replayed; 8 different receipts racing one ticket → 1 consumed, 7 conflicting_receipt HOLDs; settlement racing release_offline_ticket ends in exactly one terminal ledger event) — held. A8 live authorization (anon, service_role, no API key, no session, expired session, banned user → 42501 and nothing durable; direct table access denied; foreign owner HELD; owner settles once) — held. A9 live free-rating conservation (partial/abstaining/contradictory/out-of-range/far-future outputs never charge; honest receipt charges once; replayed operation under fresh receipt id HOLDs; lifetime_scored_count changes only for the honest scored result) — held. A10 live crash between steps (rolled-back settlement leaves no shot/ledger/settlement row and SETTLES on redelivery; unused-ticket return then late receipt → HOLD; foreign-session evidence not written) — held.

ACCEPTANCE RE-RUN ON afb40817 (VERIFIED): AC1 npx --yes deno@2.5.6 check --node-modules-dir=none --frozen --lock=deno.lock supabase/functions/api/index.ts → exit 0 (ac1_deno_check.log). AC2 cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && XC_PG_URL=postgres://postgres:pg@127.0.0.1:55433/postgres PICKLE_AUDIT_PG_URL=postgres://postgres:pg@127.0.0.1:55433/postgres deno task test → exit 0, 1006 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored (ac2_edge_suite_candidate_full.log; note: with only XC_PG_URL set the run is 994 passed / 12 ignored because W06-01 tests key off PICKLE_AUDIT_PG_URL — the package's literal AC2 command therefore does NOT reach ignored==0 by itself). AC3 ./supabase/tests/run_rls_tests.sh → exit 0, 4 scenarios (fresh, ordered_20260907, production_20260906, upstream_20260906) each 'Analysis release policy authority: PASS', W07 14/14 and W08 5/5 concurrent scenarios (ac3_rls_candidate.log). Disposable postgres: pickle-xc-pg (postgres:16 via __wf__/xc_pg_up.sh, port 55433); never touched project ucqnaiwqwjtgvlduiuib. AC4 (candidate's own regressions on base) was not re-run by the adversary — UNKNOWN here (reviewer's task).

VERDICT: 2 P1 + 1 P2 confirmed breaks → candidate should be REJECTED/requeued. Money-safety held under every attack (no double consumption, no charge for partial/replayed/held work, no unauthorized settlement); the breaks are (1) the route is unreachable by the shipping app's receipt drain (wire-shape mismatch on both request and response — nothing in apps/mobile calls the route as written, so the behaviour objective is not met end to end), and (2) the reversible deny-new freeze gate runs before the durable identity/replay lookup in reconcileOfflineReceipts, so settled/held/conflicting receipts are mis-answered as pending/reserved while a release is frozen.

implement.approach: Coordinator requeue of the REJECTED r4 candidate (de02212a; verify-6 adversary breaks P1/P1/P2). (1) settle_offline_receipt() [forward-only 20260910120000, replaced in place on the never-applied file] now inspects the ticket's terminal ledger state on the not_chargeable branch too: a receipt naming a ticket the ledger already CONSUMED (another rating) or RELEASED (device returned it) is a durable conflicting_receipt HOLD with the ticket untouched, never result_recorded/reserved that contradicts the ledger; exact redelivery replays the hold. (2) POST /v1/offline/receipts: offlineReceiptReleaseLineage() distinguishes the reversible control-plane freeze (deny_new_authorizations=true, release approved, withdrawnAt null/future) from permanent withdrawal (withdrawnAt<=now). Chargeable work under a freeze is answered delivery:'pending' (reconciliation status 'pending', financialDisposition reserved / not_applicable for a Pro lease) with NO settle RPC and nothing durable, so the identical redelivery settles once the freeze lifts; abstentions still settle under a freeze; only withdrawnAt is the durable grant_revoked HOLD. Regressions: security_regression.sql U3 rcpt-11b (not_chargeable under a CONSUMED ticket -> conflicting_receipt, events unchanged allocated:2,consumed:2, replay idempotent; U3 durable count 22->23) and U8 (release t2 then not_chargeable receipt -> conflicting_receipt, no ticket movement, no shot, replay idempotent); offline_receipt_reconciliation.test.ts +2 route tests (ticketed freeze -> pending, lift -> replay+settle; Pro-lease freeze -> pending not_applicable, later withdrawal -> grant_revoked). residual_risks: A receipt during a reversible freeze is answered pending, the device keeps it queued and redelivers (same path as the unsynced-session pending); if the release is later withdrawn the redelivery becomes the durable grant_revoked HOLD. Mobile already treats delivery:pending as retry-later (W04-05), no mobile change.

The SQL function is the durable authority for terminal-ticket detection on every billing branch; the route-level freeze handling is defense in depth only (a caller bypassing the route still cannot record against a consumed/released ticket).
